Korostyshiv Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Zhytomyrska oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. This record contains a contradiction worth flagging: it is categorized as demolished and overbuilt, yet the source's demolished field marks it as 'no.' Korostyshiv's older Jewish cemetery had its gravestones and an ohel demolished during WWII; the site served as a market square until 1948, after which a house and sheds were built. During that construction, a Jewish resident named Kozak Mikhil collected the remaining gravestones and burials and had them reinterred at the New cemetery, documented elsewhere in this collection.
